title: Connect two carbon chains
hook: Predict the product, then compare the bonds.

knows: Structural formula bonds and common organic functional groups.
doesNotKnow: Ethoxide substitutes for bromide at the primary carbon in a Williamson ether synthesis. The new C–O bond connects the two ethyl groups.

misconception: Reaction conditions do not affect the connectivity of the product.
objective: Predict the organic product of bromoethane under the stated conditions and identify the changed connectivity.

claims.text: Question, structural diagrams, product and explanation: Bromoethane is treated with sodium ethoxide. Which major organic product forms after workup? Ethoxide substitutes for bromide at the primary carbon in a Williamson ether synthesis. The new C–O bond connects the two ethyl groups.
The diagrams use condensed labels and depict connectivity rather than molecular geometry; highlighting identifies selected changed groups.
